title: Source closure, publication and qualification gate
summary: Restoring a missing source closure is necessary before claiming that NotNotes and the Initech consumer can be built independently from GitHub main.
invariants: An omitted source dependency is an explicit release blocker, not an accepted external prerequisite by accident.
A GitHub sphere source directory is not equivalent to an activated/validated Gopher catalogue sphere.
Published package resolution must be deterministic, pinned, and work without manually assembled REXX_PATH.
Do not publish reconstructed pseudocode under the missing class filenames.
procedure: Recover authentic archives for Alchemy NotNotes, Mini NotNotes, management-review fixture and the accepted Help Desk.
Record archive SHA-256 and individual file hashes, verify expected public classes and transitive ::requires dependencies.
Place independently versioned platform and app code in source packages, not only inside consumer-delivery ZIPs.
Document declared dependency roots and compatibility versions, then run ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 platform, app and Help Desk tests from clean source checkout.
Register, validate and lint this NotNotes sphere using LLM Gopher and retain results; mark source candidate until then.

provenance.claim: Consumer archive contains vendored dependency closure deliberately excluded from GitHub source import.
